package.name: tf_tree_bench_ros
package.description: The end-to-end comparison `docs/PHASE5.md` §9.1 specifies: N tf2 consumers over a real DDS against a bridge plus N tf_tree consumers, on identical data with identical QoS. Benchmark-only; nothing here is shipped, and it is a separate package from `tf_tree_ros` so a deployment never installs a benchmark.
